test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: Select an appropriate title for the passage from the given options.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1** i.e. **Steel Industry.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **passage extensively discusses** the properties, production, and numerous applications of steel in various industries.
 
• **It highlights **the central role of steel in modern industrial practices, making it a comprehensive overview of the steel industry's significance.
 
• The **other options either focus on **too narrow an aspect (e.g., "Resources of Steel") or unrelated topics (e.g., "Mineral ores," "Manufacturing").

Therefore, the **correct answer **is **Steel Industry.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: Mineral ores**. This is misleading as the passage does not focus on the sources of steel (mineral ores) but rather on steel itself and its applications.
 
• **Option 3: Manufacturing. **This option is too broad and does not specifically highlight the key focus of the passage on steel.
 
• **Option 4: Resources of Steel.** While relevant, this title does not capture the full scope of the passage which covers more than just the resources.
